message:
Remove custom codeql.yml workflow to fix conflict with GitHub default setup

The 'Analyze Python' job failed with: 'CodeQL analyses from advanced
configurations cannot be processed when the default setup is enabled'.
The repository has GitHub's built-in default Code Scanning setup enabled,
which conflicts with the custom codeql.yml advanced workflow. Removing
the custom workflow resolves the conflict.
